page.overview:
Who is Domino Petachi?

Domino Petachi is the mistress of Maximillian Largo. The character was loosely based on the Thunderball character Domino and appeared in the non-Eon 1983 James Bond film Never Say Never Again, portrayed by Kim Basinger.

In the non-Eon film Never Say Never Again, Domino Petachi is structured after Domino Derval, but this time she is played by Kim Basinger. The character is still called Domino, but now it is no longer just a nickname, but her last name has become Petachi, the reason for this change is unknown. Although somewhat less assertive than the Thunderball version - being clearly terrified when she is nearly sold off to a group of Arabs, despite this, she kills Largo and avenges her brother. The film ends with Bond retiring from the service to be with her.

Never Say Never Again represented the high water mark of a long legal battle between United Artists and Kevin McClory. For more information see: the controversy over Thunderball.
